lines.t: Verse 1:
I’ve been running in circles, chasing my pride,
Building my walls just to hide what’s inside.
Every mistake, I wore like a crown,
But grace keeps calling me down.
Pre-Chorus:
When my fear’s the loudest sound,
You pull me up before I drown.
Chorus:
You light me up, when I’m burning out,
Pull me close when I’m filled with doubt.
Your love is louder than the night,
Breaking chains, You make it right.
I’m done pretending I’m fine —
You’re my unbreakable light.
Verse 2:
All my regrets tried to own my name,
But You tore the pages, rewrote my shame.
Now every scar is a story You saved,
I’m not afraid of the waves.
Pre-Chorus:
Every fall You turn to flight,
You’re the fire in the fight.
Chorus:
You light me up, when I’m burning out,
Pull me close when I’m filled with doubt.
Your love is louder than the night,
Breaking chains, You make it right.
I’m done pretending I’m fine —
You’re my unbreakable light.
Bridge:
I was lost in the noise of my pain,
But You whispered my name through the rain.
Now I stand where the darkness dies,
Yeah, I’m still learning how to fight,
But I’m not fighting alone tonight.
You light me up, when I’m burning out,
Pull me close when I’m filled with doubt.
Your love is louder than the night,
Breaking chains, You make it right.
I’ll keep shining, I’ll keep the flame —
Forever changed by Your name.
I’m done pretending I’m fine —
You’re my unbreakable light.
